saw_lines: Beauty box buyers do the math first, counting full-size products against the price, and many buy one as a gift.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the value either shows up or gets scrolled past.
Your 6 of 11 ads open on the same 13€ line, so test three new openers: 27 full-size items, a box with no commitment, and the calendar.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Nov 2026
points: 6 of your 11 ads open on the same line, so a scroller sees the same pitch twice. Test three new openers: 27 full-size items worth 612€, a box with no commitment, and the Christmas calendar as a gift.
None of your 11 ads is video, so buyers never see the 27 products open on screen. Shoot three short clips of the box being opened and the products in use, then run them against the 13€ opener.
One exact copy runs in 6 of your 11 ads, so buyers meet the same pitch again in each placement. Keep the body, write a new opening line and a different image for each of those six.
Your ads quote 11.000 reviews only in body copy, so a buyer who reads the headline sees no proof. Put the review count on the image of each ad, and lead with an order figure you can publish.

ads_1: Product-led openers and short video, tested against the 13€ line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
